source.label: Video or podcast URL or file

brand_dir.label: Brand folder: voice notes and past top posts

steps.title: Read the brand voice
steps.prompt: Read {{inputs.brand_dir}}. Write {{run.dir}}/voice.md: the voice rules in short lines, words to avoid, and the three past posts that did best with why. Do not edit the brand folder.

steps.title: Pick the angles
steps.prompt: Transcript: {{run.dir}}/words.json. Voice: {{run.dir}}/voice.md. Pick 3 to 5 angles, each with a hook and the concrete detail from the source that carries it. Drop any angle with no concrete detail. Write {{run.dir}}/angles.md.

steps.title: Draft per platform
steps.prompt: Using {{run.dir}}/angles.md and {{run.dir}}/voice.md, write one post per angle for each of {{inputs.platforms}} in that platform's own format: a LinkedIn post, an X thread, an Instagram carousel as slide texts. Write {{run.dir}}/drafts/<platform>-<angle>.md, one file per post.

steps.title: Make the visuals
steps.prompt: For each post in {{run.dir}}/drafts/, make its visual at the platform's size: carousel slides or a quote card. Build each as a small HTML page and render it to PNG with a headless browser. Save the images in {{run.dir}}/visuals/ named after the post file.

steps.title: Cut AI tells
steps.prompt: Edit every post in {{run.dir}}/drafts/ in place against {{run.dir}}/voice.md: cut AI tells, generic claims and filler, keep numbers and specifics. Then give each post a posting slot in the week from {{inputs.week_start}}, ISO with the Sydney offset. Write {{run.dir}}/posts.json as a list of items with id, title (platform and hook), preview (first line), reason, status pending, plus platform, text_file, image and slot. Set the output key items to that path.

steps.title: Approve the posts
steps.gate_summary: Approve or drop each post in {{run.dir}}/posts.json, then approve to schedule every approved post. Dropped posts are not sent.

steps.title: Schedule the approved posts
steps.prompt: Schedule every post in {{run.dir}}/posts.json whose status is approved, with its text and image, at its slot, on its platform. Skip every other post. Record each scheduled post and its link in {{run.dir}}/scheduled.md and set count to how many were scheduled.
